reason: I already pay a setter and I'm not swapping a person who knows my offer for a tool with zero published results. AI DMs read robotic, and a 3-day trial is too short to see whether anyone replies, so I'd be paying $147 final to find out nothing.
objection: AI-written first DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell. There are no customer results, so nobody has shown it books calls, and three days of trial can't prove it either.
would_change_my_mind: A few real agency owners showing reply and booked-call numbers from cold DMs this tool wrote, or a trial long enough (14 days) to run a real batch of outreach before the card is charged.
